answer: New identities start with zero reputation and pay an entry fee of 500 POA that only returns after 40 epochs of honest work. A mirror attacker creating 50 accounts fronts 150000 POA in fees, and since reputation decays every lagoon window unless refreshed, fakes that rest lose standing fast. The orchard graph tracks who vouched for whom, so a cluster of new puppets all vouching for each other is flagged and their fees withheld.
